digest.component_or_area: llm runner and structured request builders
propositions: Fourteen call sites hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with no shared constructor, creating maintenance burden and invisible bounding decisions.

RunRequest contract requires single_turn requests to carry mode=structured and output_schema consistently, but this coupling is enforced only by repetition across fourteen sites rather than by API design.

Only one of fourteen sites declares bounding seams (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s), making intentional inheritance indistinguishable from accidental omission and enabling silent unbounded calls.

The existing AST oracle for call site verification matches only RunRequest(...) calls, so adoption of a RunRequest.for_structured classmethod would cause the oracle to silently stop seeing fourteen sites and fail to validate their bounds declarations.
A shared constructor with required bounds argument will make the bounding decision explicit and greppable at every call site while pinning the invariant to one place.
